title: 第207章 祖剑的召唤第206章 第四十五重天的擂台
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天

第207章：祖剑的召唤
传送阵的光芒散尽，广场上只剩下剑意未消的冷风。
季长风站在原地，手指还捏在剑鞘上，指节发白。叶寒霜站在三丈外，白袍上的剑意凝而不散，周身三尺之内的空气还在发出细微的嘶嘶声。
两个天剑阁最后的剑修，隔着三丈青金石板对视。
沉默了很久。
久到班定远忍不住咳嗽了一声，久到何大壮把肩上弯柄铁锤换了个肩膀，久到赵独锋独眼里的瞳孔缩了又放。
“师叔。”季长风先开口了，声音不高，但称呼变了，“你从废墟底下爬出来，就是为了骂我一句？”
“不是骂你。”叶寒霜的声音冷得像淬过冰，“是告诉你——天剑阁还没亡。你师父以身祭剑护住了剑冢，不是让你跟着一个炼体士打拳的。”
季长风的嘴角扯了一下。
不是笑。
是某种被压了很久的情绪在嘴角上裂开一道口子。
“我师父临死前把剑主令传给我，要我重建天剑阁。这句话我记了十二年。十二年在矿局牢房里，每天挨鞭子的时候都在背——‘剑主令在人在，剑主令失人亡’。”
他把手伸进怀里，摸出一块令牌。
令牌只有巴掌大，通体漆黑，正面刻着一把剑，背面刻着“天剑”二字。令牌边缘有一道极深的裂痕，是被剑气劈出来的——当年他师父以身祭剑时，剑气余波劈裂了令牌，也劈裂了天剑阁最后一道护山大阵。
“但剑主令还在，天剑阁的剑谱还在，天剑阁的剑意还在。”季长风把令牌重新收回怀里，“我没有一天不想重建山门。矿局破了天剑阁之后把剑阁旧址用困灵阵封了，我一个人的剑破不开困灵阵。跟着苏意打穿三十六重天，不是为了跟他混——是为了找能破开困灵阵的力量。”
叶寒霜盯着他看了三息。
“你找到了？”
“找到了。”季长风转头看向传送阵刚才亮起的位置，“不是力量，是人。他能用拳头打穿三十六重天的禁制，就能用拳头打穿困灵阵。”
苏意站在传送阵外的虚空边缘。
他已经从第四十四重天回来了——身上带着一百零八面铜镜全部碎裂的碎屑，拳面上多了一层极薄极亮的铜光。班定远看见他身上那些铜镜碎屑时，眼睛都直了。

但苏意没提第四十四重天的事。
他走到季长风和叶寒霜之间，把背上的还债剑解下来。
剑鞘上刻着的矿奴工号在魂晶碎片的光芒下泛着极沉极哑的光——甲零三。天剑阁欠流放之地矿奴的债，甲零三用命讨回来的债，苏意用这把剑替他讨完了。
苏意把还债剑递向季长风。
“这把剑是甲零三替天剑阁还债的剑。现在天剑阁的债还清了——你是天剑阁现任剑主。要重建天剑阁，这把剑该放在重建后的天剑阁正殿里。”
季长风接过还债剑。
剑身上的矿奴工号在他的剑意灌注下重新发出极低极沉的嗡鸣。嗡鸣声不高，但极深极沉，像从地底深处传来的矿脉脉动。剑鞘上那道被石魈爪刃劈出来的裂痕还在，剑锷上那枚拳符也还在——苏意在剑身上留的印记，一样没动。
季长风握剑的手在抖。
不是怕。
是十二年来第一次握住属于天剑阁的剑。
“我师父临死前把剑主令传给我的时候，说了一句话。”季长风的声音很低，“他说天剑阁的剑道不是杀人的剑，是护人的剑。当年天剑阁覆灭，不是剑不够快——是护的人太少。只有剑修，没有剑鞘。”
他把还债剑横在身前，左手按住剑鞘，右手握紧剑柄。
“这把剑叫还债。还的是天剑阁欠流放之地的债，欠矿奴的债。重建天剑阁之后，这把剑会放在正殿正中央——不是供人拜，是让每一个进天剑阁的剑修都记住：剑是债，学了就要还。”
叶寒霜盯着季长风手上的还债剑看了一会儿。
然后她忽然收剑入鞘。
剑入鞘的声音极清脆，像冰柱断在石板上。她周身三尺之内的剑意在同一瞬间全部收敛，空气里那些嘶嘶作响的细小剑痕消散得干干净净。
“你有这个心，你师父就没白死。”叶寒霜的声音还是冷，但冷里多了一层极薄的温度，“天剑阁的事可以等。但我还有一件事。”
她的眼神变了。

Chapter 207: Summoning of the Ancestral Sword
The light from the teleportation array dissipated, leaving only the cold wind that lingered in the square.
Ji Changfeng stood there, his fingers still clenched on the scabbard, his knuckles turning white. Ye Hanshuang stood three feet away, the sword intent on his white robe was still condensed, and the air within three feet around him was still making a subtle hissing sound.
The two last sword cultivators of Tianjian Pavilion looked at each other across a three-foot lapis lazuli slab.
There was silence for a long time.
Ban Dingyuan couldn't help coughing, He Dazhuang changed the curved-handled hammer on his shoulder, and the pupil in Zhao Dufeng's one eye shrank and widened.
"Uncle Master." Ji Changfeng spoke first, his voice was low, but his title changed, "You crawled out from under the ruins just to scold me?"
"I'm not scolding you." Ye Hanshuang's voice was as cold as ice, "I'm telling you that Tianjian Pavilion is not dead yet. Your master sacrificed his sword with his body to protect the sword tomb, and he didn't ask you to box with a body refiner."
Ji Changfeng's mouth twitched.
Not a laugh.
It was some kind of emotion that had been suppressed for a long time that cracked the corner of his mouth.
"My master passed the Sword Master's order to me before he died, asking me to rebuild the Tianjian Pavilion. I have memorized this sentence for twelve years. In the mine bureau cell for twelve years, I recited it every day when I was whipped - 'The Sword Master's order is when the person is alive, and the person who loses the Sword Master's order is dead'."
He reached into his arms and took out a token.
The token is only as big as a palm and is completely black. A sword is engraved on the front and the word "Heavenly Sword" is engraved on the back. There is a very deep crack on the edge of the token, which was split by the sword energy - when his master sacrificed his body to the sword, the aftermath of the sword energy split the token, and also split the last mountain-protecting formation of Tianjian Pavilion.
"But the sword master's order is still there, the sword manual of Tianjian Pavilion is still there, and the sword intention of Tianjian Pavilion is still there." Ji Changfeng took the token back into his arms, "There is not a day that goes by that I don't want to rebuild the mountain gate. After the Mining Bureau destroyed Tianjian Pavilion, it sealed the old site of the sword pavilion with the trapped spirit formation. I can't break the trapped spirit array with my sword. I followed Su Yi and penetrated the thirty-sixth layer of the sky, not to mess with him - it was to find the power to break the trapped spirit array."
Ye Hanshuang stared at him for three breaths.
"Did you find it?"
"Found it." Ji Changfeng turned to look at the location where the teleportation array was lit up just now, "It's not about power, it's about people. He can punch through the restrictions of the thirty-sixth heaven with his fists, and he can punch through the trapping spirit array with his fists."
Su Yi stood on the edge of the void outside the teleportation array.
He has returned from the forty-fourth heaven - carrying all the fragments of one hundred and eight bronze mirrors on his body, and there is an extremely thin and extremely bright layer of copper light on the surface of his fist. Ban Dingyuan's eyes widened when he saw the broken bronze mirrors on his body.
But Su Yi didn't mention anything about the forty-fourth heaven.
He walked between Ji Changfeng and Ye Hanshuang and took off the debt repayment sword on his back.
The number of the mine slave engraved on the scabbard glowed with a very deep and dull light under the light of the soul crystal fragments - Jia Ling San. Tianjian Pavilion owed a debt to the mining slaves in the place of exile. Jia Lingsan used his life to recover the debt, and Su Yi used this sword to pay it off for him.
Su Yi handed the debt repayment sword to Ji Changfeng.
"This sword is the sword that Jia Lingsan used to pay off Tianjian Pavilion's debt. Now that Tianjian Pavilion's debt has been paid off - you are the current sword master of Tianjian Pavilion. If Tianjian Pavilion is to be rebuilt, this sword should be placed in the main hall of Tianjian Pavilion after reconstruction."
Ji Changfeng took the debt repayment sword.
The miner's horn on the sword began to make a very low and deep hum again under the infusion of his sword intent. The buzzing sound was not high, but very deep and deep, like the pulse of mineral veins coming from deep underground. The crack on the scabbard made by the mandrill's claws was still there, and the fist talisman on the sword was still there - the mark left by Su Yi on the sword remained untouched.
Ji Changfeng's hand holding the sword was shaking.
Not afraid.
This is the first time in twelve years that he has held the sword belonging to Tianjian Pavilion.
"My master said something when he passed the sword master's order to me before he died." Ji Changfeng's voice was very low, "He said that the kendo of Tianjian Pavilion is not a killing sword, but a sword that protects people. Back then, Tianjian PavilionThe reason for destruction is not that the sword is not fast enough – it is that there are too few people to protect it. Only sword cultivator, no scabbard. "
He held the debt-repaying sword in front of him, holding the scabbard with his left hand and holding the hilt with his right hand.
“This sword is called debt repayment. What is being repaid is the debt Tianjiange owes to the place of exile and the debt owed to the mining slaves. After the Tianjian Pavilion is rebuilt, this sword will be placed in the center of the main hall - not for people to worship, but for every sword cultivator who enters the Tianjian Pavilion to remember: the sword is a debt, and you must pay it back after learning. "
Ye Hanshuang stared at the debt repayment sword in Ji Changfeng's hand for a while.
Then she suddenly sheathed her sword.
The sound of the sword being sheathed was very clear, like an icicle breaking on a stone slab. All the sword intent within three feet of her body converged at the same moment, and the tiny hissing sword marks in the air dissipated completely.
"If you have this heart, your master's death will not be in vain. "Ye Hanshuang's voice was still cold, but there was a very thin layer of warmth in the coldness, "The matters at Tianjian Pavilion can wait. But I have one more thing. "
Her eyes changed.
